title: CIS Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Calculate the concept impact score of six concepts in a small dependency graph, starting from the concepts nothing depends on.

educational.topic: Learning Graphs, MicroSims, and Content Generation Rules
learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the concept impact score of each of 6 concepts in a small dependency graph, working from the concepts nothing depends on, with at least 5 of 6 correct.
prerequisites: Concept impact score and its formula

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: B has one direct dependent and C has two, yet the scores are 3 and 4. Explain why the scores are not 2 and 3.
commonMisconceptions: A concept's score counts only its direct dependents' count, not their scores.
The concept with the most direct dependents always has the highest score.
